out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS provided both English and Spanish copies of “employee illness reporting agreement” for food employees to read and sign.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: - OBSERVED: a food employee touched ready to eat spaghetti with bare hands.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. - corrective actions: EHS educated the food employee and CFM. Spaghetti was discarded.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. - Observed: kitchen hand sink hot water temperature at 71f.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. - Corrective actions: please obtain urgent service for the hand sink within 10 calendar days.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. - Observed: cooked chicken wings (72-74f) were stored in blue air 1-door prep cooler for about 3 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. - Corrective actions: CFM reheated the chicken wings to 195f.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: - Observed: portioned ranch sauce (55f) and portioned marinara sauce (55f) were stored in True 1-door display cooler overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). - Corrective actions: the abovementioned food items were discarded. PIZZATO PIZZA (Inspection Date: 08/07/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - Observed: fries (81f) were stored on prep table for about 30 minutes.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. - Corrective actions: EHS educated CFM. CFM will discard the fries within 3 hours.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed @ @ stored in such a way that they could contaminate @Equipment@ in the @Location@. - Observed: personal care items were stored on a storage rack with take away containers in dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. - Corrective actions: CFM removed the personal care items.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: - Observed: ambient temperature of True 1-door display cooler at 55f.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. - Corrective actions: TCS food items that stored in the unit for more than 4 hours have been discarded. Please obtain urgent service for the unit.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the outlets of rinse basin and sanitize basin and the floor drain is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. - Corrective actions: please create air gaps between the outlets of rinse basin and sanitize basin and floor drain within 3 calendar days.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. - Observed: a spray nozzle is attached down stream from a mop sink equipped with an atmospheric vacuum breaker.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. - Corrective actions: EHS shared information of the approved splitter with CFM. CFM will need to install an approved splitter on the mop sink within 3 calendar days.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the UNISEX room stall that is used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the 2026 Food Establishment Health Department permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. EHS REMINDED THE OWNER/MANAGER TO VISIBLY POST ALL COUNTY PERMITS ON THE WALL FOR CUSTOMERS TO VIEW. THIS INCLUDES HEALTH DEPARTMENT, FIRE MARSHAL, BPOL, ETC. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) OBSERVED RAW MARINATED CHICKEN STORED WITH COOKED CHICKEN WINGS INSIDE THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER TO STORE RAW POULTRY BELOW ANY COOKED FOODS TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION. OWNER/MANAGER MOVED THE COOKED CHICKEN WINGS AS REQUESTED.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: 1) OPENED AND RE-PACKAGED FOODS LIKE SLICED CHEESES.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER TO LABEL AND DATE ANY OPENED AND RE- PACKAGED FOODS LIKE CHEESE, PESTO, COMMERCIALLY PROCESSED PIZZA SAUCE, ETC. OWNER/MANAGER WILL LABEL THE FOODS TODAY. PIZZATO PIZZA (Inspection Date: 02/12/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: 1) PREPARED FOODS SUCH AS COOKED PASTAS (ALL TYPES), 2) COOKED CHICKEN WINGS, 3) HOMEMADE VODKA SAUCE.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER TO LABEL AND DATE PREPARED/COOKED FOODS IF THEY REMAIN UNDER REFRIGERATION FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS. OWNER/MANAGER WILL DATE THE FOODS TODAY.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following refrigerator: 1) COCA COLA 1 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR IN THE KITCHEN (FOR CONDIMENTS).
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER TO PROVIDE A THERMOMETER INSIDE THE UNIT. OWNER/MANAGER FOUND A REFRIGERATOR THERMOMETER AND PUT IT INSIDE THE UNIT.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed bottled beverages, sodas, and pizza sauce stored in direct contact with the floor in the kitchen areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER TO PROVIDE MORE NSF APPROVED DUNNAGE RACKS OR SHELVING UNITS TO STORE ALL ITEMS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION. PIZZATO PIZZA (Inspection Date: 02/12/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employee(s) observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO WEAR A HAT OR HAIR NET WHEN PREPARING FOOD. STAFF MEMBER PUT ON A HAIR RESTRAINT. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Dry Wiping Cloths and Sanitizer Solution Free of Food Debris
violations.observation: Observed dirty wiping cloths on work surfaces and at the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Dry and wet wiping cloths shall be free of food debris and visible soil. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER/STAFF MEMBER TO STORE DIRTY TOWELS IN A BIN OR CONTAINER FOR SOILED LINENS THAT NEED LAUNDERING. STAFF MEMBER MOVED THE DIRTY TOWELS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) SMALL CONDIMENT CUPS USED TO SCOOP DRY SPICES, 2) PLASTIC TAKE HOME CONTAINERS USED TO DISPENSE DIFFERENT TYPES OF FLOUR, 3) FOOD SCOOP LYING INSIDE THE CONTAINER OF SEMOLINA.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER THAT ALL FOODS SHALL BE DISPENSED USING A FOOD SCOOP OR UTENSIL THAT HAS A HANDLE. POSITION THE HANDLE TO SIT UP, OUT OF THE FOOD WHEN NOT IN-USE. OWNER/MANAGER WILL PURCHASE MORE FOOD SCOOPS BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION. CUPS WERE REMOVED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: 1) LARGE PLASTIC BINS WITH RED LIDS FROM HOME DEPOT.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER TO REMOVE THE HOME DEPOT BINS AND PROVIDE PROPER NSF APPROVED FOOD GRADE STORAGE CONTAINERS FOR FOOD. OWNER/MANAGER WILL ORDER THEM NO LATER THAN 3 DAYS.

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit(s) are (missing, damaged): 1) WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER TO ORDER AND INSTALL A NEW DOOR GASKET FOR THE WALK-IN UNIT BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Tissue Supplied
violations.observation: Observed that toilet tissue was not provided at one of the restrooms.
violations.corrective_action: Provide toilet tissue at each toilet to minimize hand contact with fecal waste. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER TO PROVIDE TOILET PAPER IN THE ONE RESTROOM TODAY.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER TO RINSE OUT THE WET MOP AFTER USE AND HANG IT UP AFTER USE TO AIR DRY. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.
